email.subject1: a signal play for Trunk Tools
email.body1:
Ryan, saw Trunk Tools closed a $40M Series B led by Insight Partners to scale the construction AI platform.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Trunk Tools off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ryan, quick follow-up for Trunk Tools.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, and by then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Trunk Tools needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ryan, last bit of proof for Trunk Tools.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trunk Tools' reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I'll tailor it to Trunk Tools either way.
